bel_titanic_guide.text: Welcome to Titanic Belfast. The building has four points, shaped like the prows of ships.
The ship was launched from a slipway on this very site on 31 May 1911. The launch took about a minute.
Belfast is proud of the workers who built her, and not at all fussed that the story gets all the attention.

bel_titanic_shipwright.text: I am a retired plater. Every steel plate was fitted by hand, and most rivets were hammered home by riveting squads working in teams.
